# ADR 0003: Final instalment absorbs rounding

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Loan amortisation and repayment service

## Context

Rounding each instalment to kobo leaves a residue.

## Decision

Round every instalment HALF_EVEN and make the last instalment pay the exact remaining principal.

## Consequences

Principal repaid always equals principal lent.

## Alternatives considered

Spreading the residue (harder to explain to customers).
